title: oracular config
description: Everything createState needs: intents with their priors and signals, plus engine-wide options. Every duration is in the unit of the timestamps you pass as `at` (milliseconds when you use Date.now()). The engine checks the same rules at run time and rejects unknown keys; `$schema` is allowed here so a JSON file can point at this schema, and `oracular replay` drops it before handing the file to the engine.

$schema.description: Where this schema lives, for editors. Not part of the config: strip it before calling createState, or let `oracular replay` do it.

intents.description: One entry per thing the user might be about to do, keyed by the intent's name.

episodeTimeout.description: Idle gap after which the current episode ends on its own. Omit to end episodes only through endEpisode.

learning.description: How the engine learns from the user's own outcomes.

weight.description: Initial weight of a signal, in pseudo-counts. Positive is evidence for the intent, negative against.

prior.description: Prior probability of the intent, strictly between 0 and 1.

priorStrength.description: Strength of the prior as a pseudo-count.

halfLife.description: Half-life of evidence. Evidence decays back toward the prior.

outcome.description: Event name that confirms the intent happened, e.g. checkout.completed.

resetOnOutcome.description: Reset the evidence to the prior when the outcome arrives. Default true.

saturate.description: Repeats of a signal within one episode add less. Default: true when episodeTimeout is set, false otherwise.

attribution.description: How long a closed episode's signals wait for the outcome before they take a miss. An outcome inside the window credits each waiting episode by 2^(−age / halfLife). Unset: a miss at once when the episode ends.

threshold.description: Probability the intent must reach, strictly between 0 and 1. Default 0.5.

z.description: How many standard deviations below p must still clear the threshold. Default 1.28.

cooldown.description: How long after a reveal or the outcome the intent stays quiet. Default: the intent's halfLife.

bound.description: How lower is computed: the normal approximation p − z·sd (default) or the exact Beta quantile at the same one-sided level.

halfLife.description: Half-life of learned hit/miss counts. Omit for no forgetting.

gain.description: Caps learned magnitude at gain × |initial weight| for every lift option. Default 2.

priorEpisodes.description: Pseudo-count behind the developer's initial weight: how many observed episodes it takes to weigh as much as the prior. Default 10.

lift.description: Association measure, converted to an evidence score in [-1, 1], neutral at zero. Ratios use (R - 1)/(R + 1), relative/log lift use x/(1 + abs(x)), and absolute/normalized differences keep their scale. Default normalized-difference preserves existing behavior. Association-rule compares with the overall outcome rate.
